hero.headline: Building a local brand on hygiene and quality.
hero.description: Learn about the people, purpose and working practices behind our growing manufacturing operation in Kampong Speu, with hygiene, quality and responsible local production at the center.
hero.imageAlt: Illustrative noodle production facility image; not the company’s actual factory

overviewText: LM MANUFACTURING CO., LTD. is a Cambodian instant noodle manufacturer based in Kampong Speu, focused on developing locally made products for everyday consumers.
storyText: Our journey is still taking shape. As the company grows, we will share meaningful progress and updates from our work in Cambodia.
imageAlt: Illustrative instant noodle production line; actual company photographs pending

owner.title: Message from Our Owner
owner.name: Huon​ Liming
owner.photoAlt: Owner of LM MANUFACTURING CO., LTD. — replace with approved portrait
owner.message: Our company is being built with a long-term commitment to quality, responsibility and steady growth. We aim to create food products that customers can trust while developing a strong team and reliable manufacturing operation in Cambodia.

mission: To produce convenient food in Cambodia through hygienic working practices, consistent quality, responsible teamwork and continuous improvement.
vision: To become a trusted Cambodian food manufacturer known for quality and for helping strengthen confidence in locally made products.

values.title: Hygiene
values.text: We value clean, orderly and responsible working practices throughout our daily operations.

values.title: Quality
values.text: We pay attention to every step and keep improving our processes to support more consistent product quality.

values.title: Local Progress
values.text: We want our growth to contribute to stronger local production and greater confidence in products made in Cambodia.

milestones.event: LM Manufacturing begins developing its manufacturing operation in Kampong Speu, marking the start of a long-term journey in Cambodia.
